strings.cin.c3.trains.konrad.base: The plans for Kordon-17 are in the drawing tube. More than that, I am told, I need not know.
strings.cin.c3.trains.konrad.evidence: The copy lies in the drawing tube, between two blueprints that nobody unrolls.
strings.cin.c3.trains.konrad.suspicion: My enquiry received no answer. Only this official trip.
strings.cin.c3.trains.alexei.base: Three wagons are missing in Karsk. I’m going after them, with orders I don’t quite understand.
strings.cin.c3.trains.alexei.irina: Irina countersigned my travel order. Her name rides with me now.
strings.cin.c3.trains.alexei.secrecy: Irina didn’t ask why I volunteered for this trip. That was worse than any question.
strings.cin.c3.trains.place: Veltrava, Free City on the Line. February 1964.
strings.cin.c3.close.train: 23:40, Platform 5. A special train to Kordon-17, non-stop.
